Jane —

Appreciate the clarity. Attached is a first-pass MAP evidence tracker (MAP-evidence-tracker.xlsx) and a short acceptance-tests doc (acceptance-tests.md). High level summary below and proposed owners/dates.

Summary of objective
- Demonstrate safe, reliable clinician query routing and structured output for decision support flows.

Exit gates (hard)
- Quality: >=95% pass rate on our clinical-sample concordance test set (N=500), measured by your SMEs and our independent evaluator.
- Latency: end-to-end p95 < 350ms for single-turn queries under expected pilot load (30 rps).
- Cost: estimated token cost <= $0.002 per token for inference in the MAP profile (with caching enabled).
- Security/Compliance: SOC2 Type II summary + dataflow diagram + access control matrix submitted.
- Data residency: all inference for OpsHealth pilot to run in us-west-2.

Acceptance tests (artifacts in acceptance-tests.md)
- Concordance suite (500 annotated cases) — PASS if >=95% agreement
- Latency bench (synthetic replay at 30 rps) — PASS if p95 <350ms across three runs
- Fault-injection scenario — PASS if system fails over to fallback model within 5s and no data leakage occurs
- Embeddings stability (if used) — PASS if top-10 nearest neighbor recall > 0.9 on test queries

Proposed owners & delivery cadence
- Evidence tracker & results: Vanessa Ortiz (deliver weekly snapshots: May 18, May 25, Jun 1)
- Security pack: Priyom Das (SOC2 summary + diagrams by May 20)
- Procurement/quote updates: Ben Carter (quote v2 attached)
- Executive approval (go/no-go): Marissa Cole to sign recommended decision (target: May 28)

Go/no-go scenarios
- Green: all hard gates PASS by May 27 -> move to canary cutover week of Jun 1.
- Yellow: one non-security gate marginally missed (e.g., latency p95=360ms) -> agreement on mitigation plan + 7-day extension.
- Red: security/compliance or data residency not satisfied -> immediate stop, remediation plan required before further test runs.

Attachments: MAP-evidence-tracker.xlsx (stub), acceptance-tests.md (test definitions). Also linking a shared Drive sheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/opshealth-map-v1

Let us know if you want the MAP condensed into a mutual-action PDF for procurement.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
